rationale: Lycopolitan reflex of Sahidic ⲥⲱϫⲡ̄ 'leave remaining, leave over.' The ⲭ for ϫ is regular Lyc. orthography. Used here for what the angels habitually leave behind out of their hand as they take the souls.
Lycopolitan strong/causative form on root ⲡⲱϩ 'reach.' Future relative ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲁⲧⲉⲍⲁϩ 'in which they will reach.' Distinct from accumulated ⲧⲉϩⲟ 'to reach.'

proposed_english: in the becoming-as / in the form of
rationale: ⲁ- (directional) + ⲟⲩ- (indef.) + ⲱⲱⲡⲉ (= ϣⲱⲡⲉ 'become'). 'Unto a becoming-of archons' = disguised as archons. Captures angelic incognito-mode in the policing of archonic transgressions.
Likely Lyc. reflex of ⲟⲩⲱⲧⲃ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'pass over, transfer' with 3pl object. Captures the angelic translation of captive souls from archonic possession to angelic midst.

Future ⲛⲁ- + ⲃⲱϣ 'be naked, stripped' with 3pl reflexive object. The archons strip themselves of the tree and flesh as the soul-particles ascend to the upper place. Pair-partner with ⲕⲱⲕ ⲁⲍⲏⲩ in glossary.
Lycopolitan ⲁⲙⲕ̄ = Sahidic ⲱⲙⲕ̄ 'swallow.' The 3pl object form ⲁⲙⲕⲟⲩ = 'swallow them.' Captures the cosmogonic motif of archonic devouring of light through fleshly procreation.
